name: view_duel_auto_uncork_while_behind
description: The client's own uncorking at 24 s runs before the fizzle in a networked duel whose window plays about 50 ticks behind the turns it holds (tests/net/loopback_main.gd against the fake sequencer in mode undertow, 150 ms each way). Such a game still takes orders (it is not catching up below Playout.CATCH_UP_TURNS), but an UNCORK it sends is stamped into a turn after the newest it holds, and later by the trip: sent at its own tick auto_uncork_t it would land past fizzle_t and the bottle would fizzle quietly. Game times it by the turns held (Game.auto_uncork_send_tick, TurnSource.order_lead), so it goes out that much earlier and lands by about 24 s. My cork in window 2; in wave 2 my game hangs for 30 frames 1395 ticks after the horn, holding 40 to 60 ticks it has not run; the UNCORK goes out at once and lands well before 25 s, the bottle uncorked and not fizzled, and both games agree.

steps.msg: my cork went out through the server's turns, its salt kept here

steps.assert: node('LoopbackMain').sealed('UNCORK') == 0 and Game.my_bottles()[0]['uncork'] < 0 and Game.auto_uncork_send_tick() > Game.sim.tick
steps.msg: nothing uncorked yet: level with its turns, its own uncorking is still to come

steps.assert: lag >= 40 and lag <= 60 and not scene.client.catching_up and Game.accepts_commands()
steps.msg: about 50 ticks behind the turns it holds, the game still takes orders
the client's own UNCORK landed well before fizzle_t
